mapper.sql: id, email, name, tier, job, client_org_id, password_hash, status, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM account WHERE lower(email) = lower(#{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account (email, name, tier, job, client_org_id, password_hash, status) VALUES (#{email}, #{name}, #{tier}, #{job}, #{clientOrgId}, #{passwordHash}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'pending'))
